appearances.title: OS-Omni: Benchmarking Generalist Computer-Using Agents on Long-Horizon Workflows Across Platforms
appearances.summary: A live cross-platform benchmark evaluates computer-using agents on long-horizon workflows across Windows, Ubuntu, macOS, iOS, Android, and Web, showing that current agents remain far from platform-robust computer use and trail humans on iOS and macOS.
